description: evermore is folklore's moodier little sister and honestly she might be my favorite 😭✨ 'champagne problems', 'tolerate it', 'no body no crime', 'right where you left me'?? it's giving indie folk perfection and the Haim collab is everything. The storytelling is unmatched and it's criminally underrated because it dropped in folklore's shadow. Every song is a whole novel and I am obsessed 💅🔥
